load_quantizer_model: load a quantizer model from a checkpoint path choosing between LinearQuantizer and KmeansModel
create_linear_quantizer: create a LinearQuantizerModel that maps upstream features to discrete codes using a trained encoder
create_kmeans_model: create a KmeansModel that assigns input features to nearest cluster centers from a checkpoint
run_linear_quantizer_forward: run the LinearQuantizerModel forward pass to convert feature embeddings into discrete token codes
run_kmeans_forward: run the KmeansModel forward pass to assign batched or unbatched features to cluster indices
